ports.detail: 2x 1GbE RJ45 (Control & AV) - dual interfaces isolate multicast AV traffic from the managed IT network

profiles.role: SDVoE transceiver (encoder or decoder, software selectable)

ports.detail: Configurable as input or output for a discrete audio stream or HDMI de-embedding
USB HID for keyboard and mouse extension

audio: High-bitrate multichannel passthrough including Dolby Atmos and DTS:X
Balanced analog audio port configurable as input or output
profiles.latency: Genlock mode: uncompressed 30us, compressed <120us. Fast Switch mode: 1-2 video frames, approx 16.7-33.4ms @60fps.
dependencies: Requires a 10GbE SDVoE-capable managed AV network - it will not run on a 1GbE switch
Requires a NetworkHD controller (NHD-CTL-PRO-V2) for configuration and control
Never mix 600 series 10G with 1G NetworkHD series in the same transport design
checks: Confirm the network is 10GbE and SDVoE-capable before quoting 600 series.
As a transceiver, each unit is either an encoder or a decoder - confirm the count of each role in the design, not just the total unit count.
Encoding at 4K60 4:4:4 8bit is documented as using light compression; confirm this is acceptable where the customer has specified fully uncompressed.
warnings: The datasheet describes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit as '8.7Gbps (with light compression)'. Do not present this as uncompressed without qualification.
